title: Finite indexed precoverage closure axioms
statement: Let C be a category and P a precoverage [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Define stability under finite base change by requiring any family of pullback squares indexed by a finite set, whose original family covers, to give a covering family. Define stability under finite composition by requiring the composite of a finite indexed covering family with one finite indexed covering family over each member to cover.

source.place: Sites Definition 00VH, axioms (2) and (3), restricted to finite families in Situation 0A34 and Lemma 09YL

proof.text: Use the indexed pullback and composition axioms of Mathlib Precoverage, restricting all index types to finite types. The unrestricted axioms imply these restrictions by direct application.

proof_origin: Definitions follow the finite families of Stacks 09YL; implication instances are direct applications of Mathlib axioms.
